items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: So Anita Baker comes up, and she’s got this tune that’s quite popular at the time, I can’t remember the name. And I remember the way it goes, so I play the beat that’s on the record

ctx.x: Well I’ll give you — this is what I call defensive listening, right? I’m not doing this to blow my horn but you had to do this. I used to do defensive listening in my car. Instead of putting in a jazz tape, I would turn on the radio and listen to the pop radio stations. Not my favorite music at all. But I’d listen a lot, get the feel, right?
